label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Dragging a route point slides it along tracks and walkable roads: within a finger's width (22 dp, 10-150 m) of one, the point sits on it and the pieces to the waypoints either side are re-routed along the tracks as it moves (each straight where they do not join); dragged further, it comes off and both pieces are straight. The tracks around the point and its neighbours are read once when the drag starts (TrackFollow.Graph); each move is worked out on a background thread, latest only; the final place is worked out when the finger lifts. One undo for the whole drag; a cancelled drag restores the route.
